The vector-valued function r(x,θ) parametrizes the surface of revolution generated by rotating the curve y=1+cot⁡x by 2π radians about the x-axis for x∈[π4,3π4]. Which of the following could be r?

a
⟨x,π(1+cot⁡x)2sin⁡θ,π(1+cot⁡x)2cos⁡θ⟩
b
⟨2π(1+cot⁡x)sin⁡θ,2π(1+cot⁡x)cos⁡θ,x⟩
c
⟨x,(1+cot⁡x)cos⁡θ,(1+cot⁡x)sin⁡θ⟩
d
⟨(1+cot⁡x)cos⁡θ,(1+cot⁡x)sin⁡θ,x⟩
e
⟨x,2π(1+cot⁡x)2cos⁡θ,2π(1+cot⁡x)2sin⁡θ⟩
